root_cause: A macro semantics change (from a 'size for N-1 extra elements beyond the first embedded one' formula to a 'size for exactly N elements from offsetof' formula) was not reflected correctly at one of its call sites; the call site retained an extra '+1' meant for the old formula, causing the size computation to request one more array element than actually exists in the source object being copied.
findings: While refactoring VdbeSorter/KeyInfo to use C99 flexible array members, the size computation for the KeyInfo object that is embedded/copied after the VdbeSorter struct was changed from `sizeof(KeyInfo) + (nKeyField-1)*sizeof(CollSeq*)` to `SZ_KEYINFO(nKeyField+1)`, where `SZ_KEYINFO(N)` is defined as `offsetof(KeyInfo,aColl) + (N)*sizeof(CollSeq*)`. Because `KeyInfo.aColl` is now a flexible array
